key_insight: Sage-Taiyi uses metacognitive monitoring and control to adapt scientific research targets and reasoning methods as its understanding evolves.
engineering_relevance: The architecture could guide materials and engineering investigations by connecting scientific ideation with expert-led experimental and computational validation.
method: Track evidence, assumptions, and unresolved scientific questions.
Use these assessments to revise research targets and select reusable reasoning methods.
Advance selected proposals through expert-guided validation.
evidence_signal: On Taiyi-Bench’s 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranked first on all eight metrics, scoring 54.0 Overall versus 47.9 for AI Scientist-v2; five expert-guided collaborations provided practical validation.
watch_item: Five expert-guided collaborations do not establish broad autonomous reliability or generalizable gains in materials discovery.
paper_title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
